name: create-express-boilerplate
description: Create an express-boilerplate project with only the features you pick, and generate resources inside it.
author: Mohammad Abu Mattar

scripts.build: rimraf dist && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/main.js --external:./devtools.js --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace --legal-comments=external --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import {createRequire} from 'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);"
